rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for stating that something happened as a result.

example.english: It rained heavily today, so consequently I didn't go out.
example.traditional: 今日落大雨，所以我冇出街。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 so2 ji5 ngo5 mou5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the actual outcome or consequence, often at the start of the result clause.

example.english: They forgot to bring an umbrella in the morning; consequently, they were soaked after work.
example.traditional: 佢朝早唔記得帶遮，結果放工嗰陣濕晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ziu1 zou2 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 git3 gwo2 fong3 gung1 go2 zan6 sap1 saai3
